brief: Holds a list that stays sorted: it sorts at creation and every item added goes to its place.
detail: Build one with new stzSortedList(aList) or StzSortedListQ(aList); it is a stzList, so every list method also works on the sorted content (Content, NumberOfItems, Contains ...). Numbers sort before texts; texts sort by character code, so "Apple" comes before "apple", which comes before "banana". Add, Append and the + operator insert one item at its place. The Q forms AddQ and AppendQ do not insert today.
